name: AudioMC
intro: Audio MultiChallenge 是面向端到端语音对话系统的自然多轮基准，覆盖推理记忆、指令保持、自洽性和语音编辑四个能力轴。它包含 47 名说话人录制的 452 段、共 15 小时对话与 1,712 条原子评分标准，并用固定上下文协议隔离最终轮回答能力。
build_method: Agentic 失败蓝图生成, 无脚本人类多轮录音, 原子二元评分标准, 三级质量审核
metric: 平均通过率（APR）, 平均评分标准得分（ARS）
eval_feature: 多轮, 长文本, 语音编辑
scale: 452段对话，47名说话人，15小时音频，1,712条评分标准
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.14865 sections on Audio MultiChallenge construction: extending text MultiChallenge with audio-native Inference Memory, Instruction Retention, Self Coherence, and Voice Editing axes; sampling axis-topic-persona seeds; running the Planner/Tester/TTS/Target-Audio-LM loop to extract human-friendly failure blueprints; collecting 3-8 turn unscripted human recordings; writing final-turn atomic binary rubrics; applying trained reviewer, independent QC, and research-team audit; releasing 452 conversations from 47 speakers with 1,712 rubrics; and evaluating with a fixed-context protocol, base64 audio histories, LLM-as-judge, APR, and ARS.
build_method_en: Agentic failure-blueprint generation, unscripted human multi-turn recordings, atomic binary rubrics, three-stage quality review
intro_en: Audio MultiChallenge is a natural multi-turn benchmark for end-to-end speech dialogue systems, spanning Inference Memory, Instruction Retention, Self Coherence, and Voice Editing. It contains 452 conversations, 15 hours of audio from 47 speakers, and 1,712 atomic rubrics, and uses a fixed-context protocol to isolate final-turn response capability.
